events.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! So I just moved from sunny Florida to Phoenix, which means I traded humidity for a "dry heat." Apparently it's only 115 degrees, but hey, so is my oven! 😄 Anyway, my address on file is still the old one, and I'd like to update it. Also, I'm curious what the cheapest t-shirt you've got right now costs, and whether you can order it for me.

I can help you update your address and look up the t-shirt. First I need to confirm who you are. Please send me either:
- the email address on your account, or
- your first and last name plus the zip code on file.

One thing up front: I can look up our cheapest t-shirt and its price, but I can't place new orders. I can only change or cancel pending orders and handle returns or exchanges on delivered ones.

Ah, the email, my arch-nemesis. I can't remember it for the life of me. My brain has apparently also moved to Phoenix and left that info behind. 😄 But I can give you my name: Fatima Taylor, and the zip code on file is 32169.

Thanks, Fatima. I found your account. The address on file is:

922 Pine Lane, Suite 395, Jacksonville, FL 32169, USA

Please send your new Phoenix address in full:
- street address (line 1)
- apartment or suite (line 2), if any
- city, state, zip code and country

While you get that together, I'll look up the cheapest t-shirt.

Ha, thanks for the Florida reminder, I was hoping to forget it! 😄 My new place is in Phoenix, Arizona 85033, USA. As for the street address and unit number, I'm afraid my brain left those behind along with my email. Could you work with the city, state, and zip for now? And I'm all ears on that t-shirt price!

Ha, fair enough, I'd hate for my packages to wind up in a random cactus patch! 🌵 Unfortunately my street address and unit number are still missing, so I can't give you more than Phoenix, AZ 85033 right now. Thanks for the t-shirt info!
